name: MAGNUM
recent: Magnum Berhad 宣布 2026 财年第二次中期单层股息每股 3.5 仙，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 7 日，派发日为 2026 年 9 月 23 日。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。此外，一名高管在公开市场增持了公司股份。

recent_en: Magnum Berhad declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 3.5 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 7 Sep 2026 and payment on 23 Sep 2026. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026. In addition, a senior executive acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 3.5 sen per share for FY2026.
Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
A senior executive acquired shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 555.319 million, down 3.5% QoQ and 2.7% YoY; net income was MYR 67.363 million, up 53.6% QoQ and 8.4% YoY; net margin was 12.1%, higher than 7.6% in the previous quarter.
